candidates.explanation: The offset is computed as page * limit. Pages are 1-based (the controller defaults page to 1, and the document repository uses (page - 1) * limit). Page 1 therefore skips 10 rows and starts at the 11th user. With only the two seeded users, nothing is left after the skip, so the list is empty. Page 2 skips 20 rows and starts at the 21st user.

fix.description: Use a 1-based page offset: skip: (paginationOptions.page - 1) * paginationOptions.limit
